entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Al-Nabi Jirjis Mosque was a historic religious complex consisting of a mosque and mausoleum located in Mosul, Iraq. The person buried in the mausoleum is believed to be that of Saint George, known by Muslim locals as Jirjis. The structure was destroyed in 2014 and reconstruction is believed to have commenced.
